title: Plan Changes on the Purchase and the Builder Extended Rate Lock Upfront Fee
content:
Plan changes charged on the purchase agreement raise the upfront fee percent of a Builder Extended Rate Lock.

**Rule.** Two or more plan change fee charges on the agreement add 0.125 percentage points to the upfront fee percent; one adds 0.0625 percentage points; none adds nothing. The points are added to the upfront fee percent before it is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

| Plan change fee charges on the Home Purchase Agreement ledger | Added to the upfront fee percent |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| 1 | 0.0625 percentage points |
| 2 | 0.125 percentage points |
| 3 or more | 0.125 percentage points |

The charges counted are the plan change fee charges booked on the Home Purchase Agreement ledger of the agreement the lock finances.

Hypothetical effect: an upfront fee percent of 0.250 with one plan change fee charge becomes 0.3125; with two, 0.375.
